name: Tadalafil
description: A long-acting phosphodiesterase-5 inhibitor approved for erectile dysfunction, benign prostatic hyperplasia and, as Adcirca, pulmonary arterial hypertension.

systems.note: PDE5 inhibition producing vasodilation; the labelled mechanism across all three indications.
Relief of lower urinary tract symptoms in BPH is a labelled indication.
Hepatically metabolised via CYP3A4; transaminase elevation is reported.
Dose adjustment is labelled in renal impairment.

monitors.why: Hepatic metabolism with reported transaminase elevation.
Labelled dose adjustment in renal impairment.
